newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries pare gains on more profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries pare gains on more profit-taking.

text.p: *U.S. Treasuries cut gains late morning on profit-taking *Profits booked when September bond contract reached 115-20 *Test of 115-04 seen possible, which could lead to below 115 *Early gains made on dips buying after jobless claims fell 42,000 in July 19 wk. Data said skewed due to special factors
